metadata.description: Prefix used in resource names created by this template. Use lowercase letters; short prefixes are recommended because some Azure resource names have length limits.
Virtual network resource group name
Virtual network name
CIDR of virtual network
Subnet 1: existing management subnet name. Mandatory.
Subnet 2 / NIC 2: existing diagnostic subnet name. Required when numberOfInterfaces is 4 or higher; not used when numberOfInterfaces is 3 (no diagnostic NIC is created).
Subnet 3 / NIC 3 (NIC 2 when numberOfInterfaces is 3): existing inside/data subnet name. Mandatory first data interface.
Subnet 4 / NIC 4 (NIC 3 when numberOfInterfaces is 3): existing outside/data subnet name. Mandatory for NLB deployments.
Subnet 5: optional additional data subnet name. Required only when numberOfInterfaces is 5 or higher.
Subnet 6: optional additional data subnet name. Required only when numberOfInterfaces is 6 or higher.
Subnet 7: optional additional data subnet name. Required only when numberOfInterfaces is 7 or higher.
Subnet 8: optional additional data subnet name. Required only when numberOfInterfaces is 8 or higher.
Subnet 9: optional additional data subnet name. Required only when numberOfInterfaces is 9 or higher.
Subnet 10: optional additional data subnet name. Required only when numberOfInterfaces is 10 or higher.

Number of FTDv VMSS NICs to create. When set to 3, NLB uses NIC1 management, NIC2 inside, and NIC3 outside with no diagnostic NIC. When set to 4 or higher, NLB uses NIC1 management, NIC2 diagnostic slot, NIC3 inside, and NIC4 outside; subnet5 through subnet10 are optional additional data NICs.

Diagnostic setting written into FTDv day0 custom data. When ON, subnet2/NIC2 is used as the diagnostic interface. When OFF, no diagnostic NIC is created and the inside subnet (subnet3) is attached at NIC2 instead of NIC3.
Inside Subnet Gateway IP
Internal load balancer IP in inside subnet.
Outside Subnet Gateway IP
Inside Zone Name
Outside Zone Name
Deployment plan. Premium is recommended for private FMC deployments because it enables VNet integration; consumption can be used when FMC is reachable without VNet integration.
Function App subnet name used when functionHostingPlan is premium.
Function App subnet CIDR used when functionHostingPlan is premium.
Private FTDv image resource ID.
Boot mode for the virtual machine (bios: Standard BIOS boot, uefi: UEFI boot with Trusted Launch, uefi_secureboot/uefi_secure: UEFI boot with Trusted Launch and Secure Boot enabled).
Size of the Virtual Machine
Username for primary account on the virtual machine (used only for vm management). This is not the admin username and 'admin' is reserved.
Password used for both the FTD VM management user and the FTD admin user. Passwords must be 12 to 72 characters long and satisfy Azure/Cisco complexity requirements.
FMC Public IP Address
Set to YES when FMC registration/API uses the FMC public IP address supplied in fmcIpAddress. This also allows FMC public IP ingress to FTD management interfaces.
FMC User name
FMC Password
Security Policy Name created in FMC
Device group name created in FMC
Comma separated License Capability list (Valid values : BASE, MALWARE, URLFilter, THREAT)
Performance tier value to use while registering FTDv instances to FMC.
Metrics used in taking scaling decision
Scale-IN threshold in % for CPU Metrics
Scale-OUT threshold in % for CPU Metrics
Scale-IN threshold in % for Memory Metrics
Scale-OUT threshold in % for Memory Metrics
Minimum required FTDs in Scale Set. Use 0 to keep the scale set empty.
Maximum allowed FTDs in Scale Set. Must be greater than or equal to minFtdCount.
Duration in minutes for which metrics samples are collected and averaged
Initial deployment mode BULK/STEP
Scaling Policy.. Refer user guide for details
FTDv health check port number.
Deletes Unhealthy VMs automatically based on health
Controls whether the autoscale Logic App workflow starts enabled after deployment.
Set to true to allow Portal/SCM zip deployment to the Function App. Disable after uploading the function package if required by security policy.
Set to true to allow FTP basic publishing credentials for the Function App. Portal zip deployment does not require FTP.

Allow HTTPS from Azure Functions only.

Allow FMC IP to reach FTD management HTTPS. When registrationUsingPublicFMCIP is YES, fmcIpAddress is the FMC public IP.
Allow the VNet-integrated Function App to reach private FMC REST APIs.
Allow FTD management interfaces to reach FMC registration tunnel port.
Allow the VNet-integrated Function App to bootstrap FTD instances over private SSH.
Allow HTTPS traffic on the data interface.
